WITH order_counts AS (
  SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) as cnt
  FROM `order`
  GROUP BY account_id
),
total_count AS (
  SELECT SUM(cnt) as total_cnt
  FROM order_counts
),
accounts_with_shares AS (
  SELECT 
    oc.account_id,
    oc.cnt,
    CAST(oc.cnt AS REAL) / tc.total_cnt as share
  FROM order_counts oc
  CROSS JOIN total_count tc
  WHERE tc.total_cnt IS NOT NULL
),
average_share AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) as avg_share_value
  FROM accounts_with_shares
),
above_average AS (
  SELECT 
    aws.cnt,
    aws.share,
    aws.share - asv.avg_share_value as share_diff
  FROM accounts_with_shares aws
  CROSS JOIN average_share asv
  WHERE aws.share > asv.avg_share_value
)
SELECT
  SUM(cnt) as total_of_counts,
  AVG(share) as average_of_shares,
  AVG(share_diff) as average_of_diffs
FROM above_average
